Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.
 

Profile

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

For our client, a company in the Ghent region that operates in the steel industry, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Overhead Crane Operator.

Your tasks: 

• You will be responsible for lifting and moving steel plates using the overhead crane.
• You will work independently.
• You must not be afraid of heights and must have good depth perception.
• You have to load the trucks with metal parts.
• Correctly positioning the metal coils in the warehouse. 
Who are you?
• You speak English well
• You live within a 30-km radius of Evergem and have your own transport. 
• You enjoy working independently and do so effectively, are not afraid of heights, and have good depth perception.
• You are a hard worker.
• Experience as a crane operator.

You will 
support the 
implementation of the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) within our European logistics network. By 
working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will ensure that packaging processes comply with 
legal requirements and meet established project objectives. 

 
• Track and monitor suppliers’ compliance with the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) to ensure project deadlines are met on time. 
 
• Organize and facilitate online meetings with suppliers. 
 
• Discussing and clarifying different types of packaging and the roles and responsibilities of suppliers. 
 
• Explaining the PPWR requirements and expectations regarding compliance. 
 
• Coordinating implementation plans and setting target dates for execution. 
 
• Closely monitoring suppliers’ corrective actions and implementation plans, including tracking progress, milestones, and deadlines. 
 
• Preparing weekly reports for management on suppliers’ compliance status. 
 
• Identifying risks, areas of concern, and escalations that require further management support. 
 
• Conducting compliance audits and checks on manufacturer labels within warehouse operations. 
 
• Verifying that packaging and labeling processes comply with applicable PPWR guidelines and internal quality standards. 
 
• Actively contributing to a compliant, efficient, and sustainable supply chain within the logistics operation.  

Education and Relevant Experience:  

 
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a technical, logistics, or business-related field. 
 
• Experience with sustainable packaging solutions is a plus.  
 
Competencies & Skills:  

 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. 
 
• You have strong communication skills and know how to interact professionally with various stakeholders. 
 
• You have a good knowledge of Excel and are proficient in using SharePoint. Knowledge of Access and Power BI for data analysis and tracking is a plus. 
 
• You are able to manage multiple vendors, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously. 
 
• You work in a structured manner and have strong organizational and prioritization skills. 
 
• You are meticulous, reliable, and able to work independently. 
 
• You take initiative and proactively follow up on tasks to achieve set objectives. 
 
• You are motivated to further develop yourself and are determined to achieve challenging goals. 
 
• You base your recommendations and decisions on facts and feedback. 
 
• You have strong planning and organizational skills. 
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, show respect for others, and believe in people’s growth. 
 
• You combine a positive attitude and a sense of humor with a strong work ethic. 
 
• You constantly contribute ideas for improvements and actively seek ways to optimize processes.

As a Salesforce Technical Lead Consultant, you lead the technical delivery of Salesforce projects from solution design to implementation. You work closely with consultants and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions.

You combine technical leadership with a hands-on approach. From supporting pre-sales and defining solution architectures to mentoring developers and contributing code yourself, you’re as comfortable presenting ideas in the boardroom as solving technical challenges in the codebase.

Experience with Salesforce architecture, integrations, and DevOps is essential. Professional proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Experience in life sciences, regulatory compliance, and data security is a plus.

For an international company in the port of Zeebrugge, we are seeking 100% EV Car Technicians.

In this role, you will be responsible for troubleshooting, vehicle diagnostics, repairs, quality inspections, software updates, and more.

You have a very good knowledge of English (spoken/written).

You have a technical background in automotive (Level 3 EV certification   working experience).

You are IT literate, with capability to surf through different working tools, reporting systems, diagnostic tool, etc.?

You are communicative as you'll have to update colleagues (technical & non-technical) on the status of the vehicles.

Primary Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and refine yeast extract-driven solutions for a variety of savory food applications, including soups, stocks, sauces, and snack flavoring systems.
 
• Drive recipe creation and continuous optimization to improve flavor intensity, enhance umami profiles, and achieve balanced taste performance.
 
• Perform sensory assessments and analyze evaluation results to support product development and strategic market positioning.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market insights into effective, scalable, and commercially viable formulations.
 
• Investigate ingredient functionality within complex food systems and resolve technical formulation issues.
 
• Carry out market intelligence activities, including competitive product reviews and emerging trend monitoring in savory applications.
 
• Provide technical support for customer projects through prototype development, problem resolution, and product demonstrations.
 
• Work closely with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to accelerate innovation initiatives and business growth.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory requirements, quality standards, and internal product development procedures.

Profile & Expertise

 
• Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
 
• Demonstrated expertise in product formulation and application development within one or more savory segments such as soups, seasonings, sauces, or bouillons.
 
• Outstanding junior professionals with strong academic achievements, internships, or relevant project experience are welcome to apply.
 
• Solid knowledge of sensory science, flavor characterization, and sensory-driven product development.
 
• Strong understanding of ingredient performance, flavor synergy, and behavior within food systems.
 
• Capable of planning and executing experiments independently while drawing meaningful conclusions from technical data.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on formulation improvement and optimization.
 
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external clients.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to connect technical solutions to customer and business needs.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
 
• Availability for occasional travel across Europe for customer meetings, industry exhibitions, and knowledge-sharing sessions at the company's headquarters in China.

Core Responsibilities

 
• Develop, refine, and enhance bakery solutions utilizing yeast-based ingredients, including baker's yeast, yeast extracts, yeast proteins, and other specialty baking components.
 
• Plan and conduct practical baking trials tailored to customer needs while aligning with current European bakery market demands and consumer trends.
 
• Lead recipe formulation and continuous product optimization for breads, viennoiseries, laminated pastries, and a wide range of fermented baked goods.
 
• Deliver technical expertise and customized product solutions to strategic customers and bakery manufacturers throughout Europe.
 
• Organize and perform bakery demonstrations in customer facilities, application centers, and industry exhibitions, both for individual clients and larger groups.
 
• Translate customer specifications and commercial opportunities into scalable formulations and effective technical recommendations.
 
• Partner closely with commercial, marketing, and global R&D teams to support innovation initiatives and business growth objectives.
 
• Monitor industry developments, competitor offerings, ingredient innovations, and advances in bakery processing technologies.
 
• Ensure all development activities comply with applicable regulations, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Professional Skills

 
• Degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Baking Technology, Milling Technology, or a related field. Practical bakery training or hands-on experience as a baker is highly valued.
 
• Minimum of 5 years' experience in bakery product development, ideally within premix manufacturers, industrial bakeries, or yeast ingredient companies.
 
• Strong expertise in bakery ingredient functionality, dough behavior, flour performance evaluation, and process optimization.
 
• Proven ability to design trials, analyze technical results, identify root causes, and resolve formulation challenges.
 
• Hands-on and solution-oriented professional capable of working autonomously in a laboratory and application environment.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to transform technical expertise into tangible customer benefits.
 
• Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working across departments and directly with customers.
 
• Excellent presentation and communication abilities, including delivering technical training sessions, demonstrations, and customer workshops.
 
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, for international collaboration; knowledge of French or Dutch is considered an asset.
 
• Flexible and willing to travel across Europe for customer meetings, trade fairs, and knowledge-sharing visits to the company's headquarters in China.

Key Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and enhance yeast-protein-based solutions for a range of food applications, including sports nutrition products, plant-based dairy substitutes, and baked goods.
 
• Drive recipe development and continuous prototype improvement to achieve targeted functionality, such as texture enhancement, emulsification, gel formation, and overall product performance.
 
• Analyze sensory evaluation results and transform insights into actionable recommendations for formulation refinement and product advancement.
 
• Perform competitive product assessments and monitor industry developments related to proteins and functional ingredients.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market expectations into effective technical concepts and scalable product solutions.
 
• Provide technical expertise for customer-focused projects, including prototype preparation, issue resolution, and technical demonstrations.
 
• Partner with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to deliver innovative products aligned with business objectives.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory guidelines, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Skills

 
• Master's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, or a closely related field.
 
• Demonstrated background in product formulation and application development within food systems such as sports nutrition, plant-based alternatives, bakery products, or similar sectors. Talented early-career candidates with relevant academic projects or internship exposure are welcome to apply.
 
• Strong expertise in sensory assessment, product characterization, and structured evaluation methodologies.
 
• In-depth knowledge of ingredient performance, protein functionality, and interactions within complex food matrices.
 
• Ability to independently plan trials, execute experiments, and draw meaningful conclusions from technical findings.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting abilities related to formulation challenges and product improvement.
 
• Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and engage with customers.
 
• Commercial awareness and the capability to translate technical innovations into business and customer benefits.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written, for international collaboration.
 
• Flexibility to travel for customer meetings, industry exhibitions throughout Europe, and knowledge-sharing activities with the headquarters in China.

As a Transport Officer you get to organize & control the transport of deliveries in order to achieve high standards of transport quality.
 

Responsibilities: 
 

 
• Organizing the collection of the finished order via the SAP transport module or entering the shipments in the relevant transport software
 
• Communicating with the forwarder to have the collection take place on time and forwarding the necessary documents (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.) as agreed
 
• Communicating with the dealers to inform them of the delivery date provided and forward the transport documents needed.
 
• Alignment with various stakeholders in case of delivery issues and complaints
 
• Loading of pallets or cartons on trucks
 
• Acceptance of small shipments and organizing the internal transfer on site
 
• Administrative support to Logistics Transport Supervisor 
 
• Optimizing efficiency and costs for all shipments done
 

Interested in this challenging job?
 

Make your appointment online at www.konvert.be send your CV to leuven.interim@konvert.be 

 
• Deep Knowledge and experience in transport (minimum 3 years)
 
• Deep Knowledge of SAP transport module
 
• Knowledge of customs regulations is a plus
 
• Knowledge of Dangerous goods regulations (IATA, ADR regulations)
 
• Great command of Dutch & English, French is nice to have
 
• Advanced in MS Office - Excel, Word, Outlook
 
• Able to work from 08:00-16:30
 
• Strong communication skills
 
• Positive mindset and motivated attitude

As a GL Accountant, you will be responsible for managing and monitoring the accounting activities of one or more entities within the organization. You will ensure accurate financial reporting and contribute to smooth accounting processes.
 

Your main responsibilities include:
 
 

•  

Performing balance sheet analyses and monthly reconciliations.
  

•  

Preparing and supporting monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closings.
  

•  

Preparing financial reports for internal management and group reporting purposes.
  

•  

Monitoring and reviewing costs, accruals, and provisions.
  

•  

Participating in the annual budgeting process.
  

•  

Supporting and coordinating external audits.
  

•  

Working closely with the controlling department and international colleagues.
  
 

•  

You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  

•  

You have several years of relevant experience as a GL Accountant.
  

•  

You have a solid understanding of balance sheet analysis, financial closings, reconciliations, and IFRS.
  

•  

You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  

•  

Experience with SAP is considered an advantage.
  

•  

You are accurate, independent, and have strong analytical skills.
  

•  

You are a team player who enjoys working in an international environment.
